regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, gold-led tape in China A-shares with only 8 of 22 themes eligible and the absolute-trend gate having demonstrably NOT helped on this market's own history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape whipsaws it). Momentum rank is attention only (rank-IC ~0), and this desk's own prior directional accuracy was 36.9% over 65 calls — so all leans are held at low conviction and framed as conditionals, not forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Banks (cn_banks, rank 8, crowded=true, crowding_z 1.62, breadth 0.944) regain eligibility despite being ineligible today. The observable condition that would retire this watch is Banks crossing into eligible=true while its crowded flag persists — that would mark a crowding-driven constrained leadership handoff from resources toward financials.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the highest-ranked scorable theme (rank 2 of 22), is eligible, shows the strongest durability_bar among scorable names (0.72) with reasonable breadth (0.846), and is not crowded (crowding_z -0.13). It is the cleanest trend-following expression of the resources leadership without inheriting the unscorable Gold Miners concentration. This is a directional lean on the theme that is actually gradable via proxy 512400.SS, justified by rank + durability + breadth, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst tag and a mean-reverting tape (per backtest) mean the trend may whipsaw; industrial metals in China are sensitive to property/credit demand, and the macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics (unscheduled share 0.88) which can reverse commodity sentiment quickly.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is an eligible scorable theme but its momentum texture is deteriorating: hurst_tag is mean-revert, durability_bar is a weak 0.42, and breadth is a very thin 0.294. This reads as a theme whose leadership is narrow and unstable, so the lean is to underweight relative to the benchmark, not a short or a fade call.
theses.dissent: AI tech is one of the four dominant macro narratives (n=7), and policy/geo headlines could reignite the theme quickly; low breadth can also mark an early accumulation phase rather than distribution.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma/CXO is the only theme that is simultaneously eligible, scorable, AND crowded (crowding_z 1.15, crowded=true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution — never a sell or short — so the cleanest honest expression of that caution is 'avoid' (do not add). The momentum rank is positive (5 of 22) but durability (0.52) and breadth (0.357) are mid-pack, giving no reason to override the crowding caution.
theses.dissent: Chinese innovative pharma has idiosyncratic licensing/approval catalysts (BD deals) that thematic momentum cannot see, and crowding in A-shares often persists far longer than expected; avoiding could mean missing a genuine structural export story.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ rises 8% or more relative to the CSI 300 while remaining uncrowded for two consecutive weeks before the 30-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
